sections.text:
Nature-related risks are now impossible to ignore. With TNFD-aligned reporting rapidly becoming mandatory across global markets, C-suite and sustainability leaders need clarity on where to begin, and confidence that their approach is built on the latest guidance.
That's why our all-women Nature Strategy team has completely updated this guide for 2026, incorporating the most recent framework developments, regulatory updates, and lessons from real-world implementations.
Why This Guide Matters Now:
The TNFD framework marks a fundamental shift in how organizations understand and manage their relationship with nature. As mandatory disclosure requirements accelerate globally, from the EU's CSRD to emerging ISSB standards, companies that act now will be better positioned to meet investor expectations, maintain their license to operate, and capitalize on nature-positive opportunities.
Whether you've heard of TNFD but haven't taken action, or you're navigating an evolving regulatory landscape, this guide provides the strategic roadmap you need to move from confusion to confident implementation.
Written by practitioners, for practitioners.
Our Nature Strategy team has guided dozens of organizations across mining, finance, agriculture, and manufacturing sectors through TNFD implementation. This guide distills that expertise into practical, actionable steps.
